world.title: Pakistan military reports it killed 74 ‘terrorists’ during raids
world.summary: Pakistan's military announced the killing of 74 armed fighters during recent raids near its border with Afghanistan. The operations, conducted in various regions, included 31 "terrorists" eliminated in Balochistan since November 3. The increase in violence has heightened tensions between Pakistan and Afghanistan, prompting military responses aimed at addressing security concerns in the border areas.

world.title: Ex-Mexico Lawyer Who Secretly Helped CIA Run Ops In His State Flees To US: Report
world.summary: A former prosecutor from Mexico's Chihuahua state has reportedly fled to the United States following an arrest warrant issued for his alleged involvement in assisting CIA operations with local security forces. The New York Times reported that U.S. and Mexican officials confirmed his escape, highlighting concerns over the implications of his actions and the ongoing investigations.

world.title: Imran Khan-Asim Munir deal? Sisters' release from jail, hospital visit spark buzz in Pakistan
world.summary: The release of former Prime Minister Imran Khan's two sisters and his recent hospital visit have sparked speculation about a potential political understanding between Khan and Pakistan's military establishment. Observers are questioning whether these developments indicate the beginning of a thaw in relations, as Khan remains jailed, and the military's influence continues to shape the country's political landscape.

business.title: Microsoft Outage LIVE: Microsoft extends mail timeout to 48 hours as outage hits governments, organisations worldwide
business.summary: A widespread outage affected Microsoft platforms, including Outlook, prompting the company to extend mail timeout to 48 hours. Microsoft reported that a portion of its infrastructure was experiencing elevated load, contributing to connectivity errors. The outage severely impacted various organizations globally, including Britain's National Health Service, as staff handling emergency calls faced significant disruptions in service.

business.title: Microsoft Teams, Outlook, and 365 services are down, more than 12 hours now
business.summary: Microsoft is facing a significant server outage impacting its cloud services, including Outlook, Teams, Microsoft 365, Azure, OneNote, OneDrive, and Microsoft ToDo. The outage has persisted for over 12 hours. Microsoft has clarified that the disruption is not due to a cyberattack, attributing the issues solely to the server malfunction affecting its operations and services.

business.title: Eicher Motors Q2 results: Net profit rises 15% to Rs 1,573 crore, misses estimates
business.summary: Eicher Motors reported a 15% increase in net profit to Rs 1,573 crore for Q2 FY27, which ended on September 30, 2026. The company's revenue from operations rose by 20% to Rs 7,422 crore during the same period. Despite the profit growth, the results fell short of market expectations, highlighting a potential disconnect between performance and analyst forecasts.

technology.title: Google Pixel 11 gets Rs 11,000 off, no conditions
technology.summary: The Google Pixel 11 is currently discounted on Amazon, priced at Rs 78,790, down from its original launch price of Rs 89,999. This promotion allows customers to save over Rs 11,000 without any additional conditions or offers required. The sale highlights the device's reduced price, making it more accessible for potential buyers looking for a smartphone deal.

technology.title: Claude down: Users report login issues and service disruptions affecting Claude.ai and Claude Code
technology.summary: Anthropic is addressing authentication issues impacting its Claude.ai and Claude Code platforms. Users, particularly in India, have reported difficulties logging in and accessing services, leading to a notable rise in complaints on Downdetector. The disruptions began on Friday, November 13, and the company is actively investigating the cause of these login problems affecting its AI services.

technology.title: New Chinese smartphone offers a massive storage option at a reasonable price
technology.summary: OnePlus has launched the OnePlus 16 smartphone, featuring 1 TB of storage at a competitive price. Known for its flagship-killer reputation, OnePlus aims to provide affordable alternatives that rival more expensive models. The introduction of this device addresses the growing demand for substantial storage options in smartphones, especially amid rising memory costs, appealing to users seeking high-capacity devices.

sports.title: Actor-Model Samreen Kaur Hits Back At Viral Reels Linking Her To Ashish Chanchlani, Warns Of Legal Action
sports.summary: Actor-model Samreen Kaur has responded to viral reels linking her to YouTuber Ashish Chanchlani, stating they haven't communicated in four years. She criticized social media users for misusing old images to generate misleading narratives and warned creators against this practice. Kaur emphasized the importance of responsible content sharing, especially regarding personal relationships and past collaborations.

sports.title: Carlo Ancelotti sends Raphinha message to Barcelona ahead of Singapore, Japan friendlies
sports.summary: Carlo Ancelotti praised Raphinha's performance at Barcelona, noting his impressive quality and versatility as a striker. In a pre-match press conference, Ancelotti emphasized the importance of monitoring players' minutes and prioritizing their health. He stated that if Raphinha is 100% fit, he will participate in the upcoming friendlies in Singapore and Japan.

sports.title: National team coach to meet with Flick to discuss Barcelona defender’s fitness amid growing concerns
sports.summary: Denmark coach Brian Riemer plans to visit Barcelona to meet with Hansi Flick regarding Andreas Christensen’s fitness. Reports indicate growing concerns about the defender's ability to maintain consistent physical condition. The meeting aims to establish a collaborative recovery plan to support Christensen's rehabilitation and ensure he can return to optimal form for both club and national team commitments.

health.title: Does Every Heart Attack Require Angioplasty or Bypass Surgery? A Cardiologist Explains
health.summary: Not every heart attack necessitates angioplasty or bypass surgery. A cardiologist outlines scenarios where medication may suffice, particularly if an artery is not severely blocked, chest pain is manageable, and blood flow is adequate. However, in cases of significant blockage or persistent symptoms, procedures may be required. Always consult a healthcare professional for personalized medical advice.

health.title: 1RA’s: Novel mechanisms and combos to shape future of obesity market
health.summary: Emerging mechanisms and combinatorial approaches are transforming the obesity treatment landscape, shifting the focus from weight loss alone to broader health outcomes. The incretin drug class has significantly impacted cardiometabolic treatment, leading to increased prescriptions for weight loss medications aimed at long-term management of obesity and its related comorbidities, indicating a shift in therapeutic strategies within the market.

health.title: World Diabetes Day: Why early prevention and regular screening are key to reducing the risk of diabetes
health.summary: World Diabetes Day is celebrated annually on November 14 to increase awareness about diabetes, its risk factors, and the significance of prevention and early detection. The 2023 theme, “Early Action on Diabetes,” emphasizes proactive measures for preventing and managing diabetes through healthier lifestyle choices, enhanced awareness, and timely screening, aiming to reduce the overall risk of the condition.

science.title: A New Study Presents New Ideas on How the World’s Forests Should be Managed to Slow Climate Change
science.summary: A new study by a scientist who addressed the "Missing Carbon" issue offers updated strategies for managing global forests to mitigate climate change. The research emphasizes the importance of forest carbon sinks and presents innovative ideas in a recently published book. The findings aim to enhance understanding and implementation of effective forest management practices to combat climate change.

science.title: day on Nov 18 — The Indian Panorama
science.summary: NASA's Voyager 1 is set to become the first human-made object to reach one light-day from Earth on November 18. Launched in 1977, the deep space probe has traveled nearly 50 years through the cosmos. This milestone marks a significant achievement in space exploration, showcasing human ingenuity and the enduring capabilities of technology in deep space missions.

science.title: Robots help uncover the secrets of the deep sea
science.summary: Robots are enabling scientists to replicate extreme deep-sea conditions in laboratories, facilitating the study of microorganisms typically lost during retrieval. The deep sea, the largest microbial habitat on Earth, hosts diverse microorganisms that have adapted to survive intense pressure and near-freezing temperatures. This research aims to uncover the unique enzymes and adaptations these organisms have developed over time.

entertainment.title: Amrita Rao’s sister Preetika Rao ties the knot in Bengaluru with the blessings of Sri Sri Ravi Shankar, hides husband’s face in wedding PICS
entertainment.summary: Preetika Rao, a television actress and sister of Amrita Rao, has married in Bengaluru. The wedding took place at the Art of Living venue, with blessings from Sri Sri Ravi Shankar. Although the exact date of the ceremony was not disclosed, Preetika shared wedding pictures online, notably concealing her husband's face in the images.

entertainment.title: Varun Grover slams 'Ramayan' TV cast for 'entitlement' over reactions to Ranbir Kapoor and Yash's 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend': 'Entitlement as if they are actual avatars'
entertainment.summary: Varun Grover criticized the lead actors of Ramanand Sagar’s ‘Ramayan’ for their entitled reactions to Nitesh Tiwari’s upcoming film, ‘Ramayana: Rise of a Legend’. He expressed concern over their comments, suggesting they act as if they are actual avatars. Grover's remarks highlight the disconnect between the original show's cast and the new film's creative direction.

entertainment.title: 'Ramayana' box office: Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Yash’s film becomes a record breaker in Vietnam, Thailand, Cambodia, and Nepal amid the film crossing Rs 1000 crore worldwide
entertainment.summary: Nitesh Tiwari’s film ‘Ramayana: Rise of a Legend’ has achieved significant box office success in its first week, surpassing Rs 1000 crore globally. The film has resonated particularly well in Vietnam, Thailand, Cambodia, and Nepal, where the Ramayana holds cultural significance. Its performance reflects strong audience support across these Asian countries, contributing to its record-breaking status.
